title: Alaskan Mario Kart remake
author: Difficult-Cheek2676
selftext:
I’m a huge Mario Kart fan and have always wanted to make something like it. With Claude Opus 5.5 and a few MCPs and plugins, I finally got a result I’m fairly happy with. It’s not perfect, but I have no game dev experience and not much 3D modeling experience, so it’s crazy to me that I got something of this caliber. Claude Opus 5.5 did most of the heavy lifting on the code: the kart physics and drifting, tricks and rail grinds, the gliding and underwater sections, the AI racers, the menus, and the lodge hub you see at the start. It’s all built on Three.js and WebGL, so it runs right in the browser and supports a PS4 controller or keyboard.

For the visuals, I used Tripo to generate the 3D models, which saved a lot of time and tokens on claude. I originally tried to have claude make it all but that really did not come out well and ran for hours. I used the Higgsfield MCP for the images and other visual assets for refrence on the modeling, and ElevenLabs Music for the music and sounds. There’s still a ton of work to do, but I’m quite impressed with how far it’s come. I haven’t published it yet, so you can’t play it right now, but if people are interested I can set that up shortly. Also I kept a devlog and find the process extremely interesting to look back on and see how far this game has come since the original iteration, if anyone is interested in that as well I could set up a way to share this publically. What are your first impressions from the demo video and what tools would you recommend to make this excperience better as I continue to make improvements?

ps. I am not a huge fan of this demo video as I feel it doesnt give off the full game experience well, but I made this with screen records from gameplay that claude mixed together in a demo style.
